scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.services: LIVEKIT_NODE_IP=$(node scripts/node-ip.mjs) docker compose up -d --wait postgres minio mongo livekit && npm --prefix backend run db:deploy
scripts.services:down: docker compose stop postgres minio mongo livekit
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm run wait-api && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
